findings.title: Declared Source drift guard trusts Git index suppression and misses index-only drift
findings.observation: Actual normal verifyReaderPageRecords succeeds after changing physical src/tree/item.txt while marking its index entry assume-unchanged or skip-worktree. It also succeeds for direct file and tree-member staged changes when physical worktree bytes are restored to the committed bytes; git diff revision is empty but git diff --cached revision lists the changed entry.
findings.repair: Keep finite declared-path acquisition. Independently compare the index to the selected revision (cached diff), and reject masking assume-unchanged/skip-worktree flags on tracked entries under declared scopes, or verify those actual physical descendants through a finite Git-owned entry census. Do not mutate/clear user index flags or infer a global closure. Add maintained file/tree staged-restored and both hidden-tree-drift negative controls.

findings.title: Normal production checker can silently downgrade to fixture mode when both unbound sentinels are removed
findings.observation: A genuine appendReaderPageRecords artifact passes the normal CLI. Delete pageRecords and build-report.json, preserving all output bytes/hashes, then the same normal CLI again exits0. Production record omission is detected only when the optional build-report file remains.
findings.repair: Make normal production artifact verification require pageRecords by default. Preserve legacy isolated renderer fixtures through an explicit fixture-only test/API/CLI mode selected by their caller, not artifact-controlled absence of both files. Add an actual CLI negative deleting both fields/files; retain a separately explicit legacy-fixture positive.
